about: Links a housing or credit law does not show in a played world, with the registered owner decision behind each. The loan rate cap binds only the bank's consumer loan, which never reaches the ceiling in an ordinary rate year, so it moves no dollar; the question for the owner is whether the game should have a payday-style lender.

money.why: The cap applies only to the bank's consumer loan (about 13 percent against a 36 percent ceiling), so no borrower's rate changes and the law moves no dollar; the game has no small-dollar lender for it to bind
